description: FuelCast is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by U.S. Forest Service (USFS). This fuel and rangeland production forecasting system provides Monthly Fuel and Rangeland Production Forecasts for rangeland managers, fire specialists, and producers. Based on near real-time weather and remote sensing data, the site provides monthly forecast estimates of the magnitude and timing of annual production and fuel across contiguous U.S. rangelands. Services available:. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Drought, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Agriculture and Food Supply, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
